label: 🧭 Top-K nearest
description: Per-row top-K nearest-neighbour search over a vector column. For each row, find the K most similar other rows and add two array columns: top_k_indices (the matching row indices or labels) and top_k_scores (the similarity / distance values). Use as the reduction step after embed_text + vector_similarity to power RAG retrieval, recommendation, and document-deduplication workflows.

metric.label: Metric
metric.help: cosine: angular similarity, best for embeddings (highest = most similar). euclidean: L2 distance (lowest = most similar). dot: inner product (highest = most similar; assumes normalised vectors).

labelColumn.label: Label column (optional)
labelColumn.help: Use this column's values to identify neighbours instead of integer row indices.

includeSelf.label: Include row itself as a neighbour
includeSelf.help: By default each row's top-K excludes the row itself (cosine similarity 1.0 with self is uninteresting). Enable to keep self in the results.
